title: Toronto-based Blue J, which provides AI-powered tax research software, raised a $176M Series E round led by JMI Equity at a $700M+ valuation (Alex Riehl/BetaKit)
summary: Alex Riehl / BetaKit: Toronto-based Blue J, which provides AI-powered tax research software, raised a $176M Series E round led by JMI Equity at a $700M+ valuation — Toronto-based Blue J has raised a $176-million USD ($249-million CAD) Series E round after more than doubling its annual recurring revenue in just over a year.
